title: Agentic system
description: JSON Schema for an agentic-system instance: a system bearing the agent-community signature. Carries the member-set of characters, the governance-process, the governing-soul-of-scope, and the kinds of community-acts the system emits.

member-set.description: Character slugs that are members of this agentic system.

governance-process.description: Reference to the governance-process record (e.g., a rule-set or charter) governing membership and decision-making.

governing-soul.description: Reference to the governing-soul-of-scope record naming the system's scope and orientation.

emits-community-acts.description: Kinds of community-acts (not attributable to any single member) the system emits.

polity-bearing.description: Whether this agentic-system additionally satisfies the polity signature (charter + offices + personnel-roster + recognition-cell).

leader.description: Character slug currently recognized as leader (when applicable).
